description: This file defines the ServerRequestFactory class, which implements the ServerRequestFactoryInterface. It contains methods to create andmarshal HTTP server request objects from PHP superglobals and environment variables, including parsing headers, URI, host, port, and request path.

classes.name: ServerRequestFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating PSR-7 ServerRequest instances from PHP superglobals and server environment variables.

methods.name: fromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a ServerRequest object from PHP superglobals; applies request filtering if provided.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates a new ServerRequest object with specified method, URI, and server parameters.

methods.name: marshalUriFromSapi
methods.description: Constructs a Uri object based on server variables and headers.

methods.name: marshalHostAndPort
methods.description: Extracts host and port from server variables and headers.

methods.name: marshalIpv6HostAndPort
methods.description: Handles IPv6 addresses when extracting host and port.

methods.name: marshalRequestPath
methods.description: Determines the request path from server variables, handling IIS URL rewrite, REQUEST_URI, and ORIG_PATH_INFO.

methods.name: marshalHttpsValue
methods.description: Converts SSL HTTPS indicator to boolean.

methods.name: marshalHostAndPortFromHeader
methods.description: Parses host and port from header string.

methods.name: getHeaderFromArray
methods.description: Retrieves a header value case-insensitively from header array.
